selected_lane_name: PRPC-Submod: Parity-Resolved Piedmont-Concordant Multi-Physics + Fold-Proper Tip/Relay Submodular Synthesis
method_paragraph: A concealed or subtly expressed Great Basin fault produces two opposite-parity geophysical signatures that prior derivative and juxtaposition lanes conflated: (1) ODD-SYMMETRY rock-state steps across the fault normal (covariance-whitened cross-strike jumps at 16 azimuths, r=300 m and 500 m, across subsurface rtp, 150 m upward-continued TMI_up150, iso_grav_anom, depth_to_base_surf, cond_surf, and surface det_elev, K, Th, U), and (2) EVEN-SYMMETRY fault-core/scarp-dipole impulses localized ON the fault trace itself (tile-seam-decontaminated 1 m LiDAR lappos/lapneg/downface/upface/step breaklines calibrated seamlessly onto 100 m DEM where 1 m tiles are absent, concave piedmont curvature -tc, mobile Uranium-series U/Th and U/K redox/radon enrichment, and potential-field horizontal-gradient crests), evaluated by axial on-trace concentration minus +-300 m flanking background rather than cross-trace differencing (fixing IR-85-006 and IR-85-007). Coupled with volcanic-mesa/paleoshoreline decontamination, GDR-1391 measured hydrothermal spring/geothermometer upflow plumes, and strictly fold-visible fault-tip continuation cones and Voronoi inter-component relay-ramp corridors (trained via inner self-excluded component splits so self-distance d=0 never occurs), two spatially-blocked out-of-fold experts (catalogue-blind P_blind and visible-network P_net) are synthesized and allocated into 37,654 binary {0, 1} off-catalogue (>200 m) dots by metric-exact 300 m triangular-kernel lazy-greedy submodular coverage.
